title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
shortTitle: Journey to the Center of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
blurb: Why is the translation history of Verne in particular such a mess? Why is the most popular version of this book on Project Gutenberg a mangled rewritten edition with Americanized character names? Why does no scan of the original Malleson edition exist literally anywhere on the internet?
blurb2: The chud George Orwell "Like most writers, Jules Verne was one of those people to whom nothing ever happens." (link) vs the chad Extraordinary Adventures "Everything he wrote about in his novels, Jules Verne actually experienced first-hand." (link). (Also from that same Orwell essay: "one can see the justification for Hitler". Real.)
